title: IT Support Services — VA Healthcare System
description: The VA requires IT support services including helpdesk, network maintenance, and cybersecurity monitoring for VA healthcare facilities in the Southeast region. Contractor must be SDVOSB-certified and demonstrate past performance in federal IT environments. This requirement is a Service-Disabled Veteran-Owned Small Business (SDVOSB) set-aside. Performance location: Florida.
notes: SDVOSB set-aside. Keywords: IT support, helpdesk, network maintenance, cybersecurity monitoring, healthcare, federal IT.
